prompt: Earth has a magnetic field strong enough to turn compass needles worldwide. That field is generated mainly by:

options.text: A giant permanent bar magnet frozen into Earth's solid inner core
Movement of electrically conducting liquid iron in Earth's outer core, acting as a dynamo
Static electricity built up in the atmosphere
Magnetised rocks in the crust all pointing the same way

explanation: The geodynamo arises from convection and rotation of liquid iron alloy in the outer core. Moving conducting fluid sustains electric currents, and those currents generate Earth's magnetic field.
